claim: Qwen3.8's per-token encode of 964 identical dispatches is not irreducible. Encoding the graph once into an Indirect Command Buffer and replaying it drops encode_host_prepare from 886 µs to 91 µs. Named fixed overhead (encode + wait-minus-gpu + submit + tokenizer + epilogue) falls from 1.332 ms mean / ~1.415 ms claimed to 0.671 ms. Greedy ids stay bit-identical on the 3-prompt Q4 seal. wait-minus-gpu rose 136 µs; the net is still a deletion.

s004_section_7.item_8_persistent_gpu_metadata: DONE. Token, position, and MHA seq_len live in a 64 KiB shared scalar slab. Static set_bytes payloads (rows/cols/eps/geometry) are interned once at ICB encode. Kernels keep their constant uint& / ArgbufMhaDecode bindings; the CPU no longer set_bytes them each token.
s004_section_7.item_9_collapse_command_buffers: Already 1 CB. The real collapse was 964 compute encoders → 1 executeCommandsInBuffer. Serial-group CPU fallback remains behind HAWKING_QWEN38_SCHEDULE=serial.
s004_section_7.item_13_function_constants: NOT REQUIRED. Persistent buffers at the existing constant-buffer slots delete the host encode work without a shader rewrite. Function constants would only remove a few interned binds on replay, which is already ~90 µs total.
s004_section_7.prefer_delete: 964 pipeline lookups + encoder create/set_buffer/set_bytes/dispatch/end_encoding per token are gone. Replay writes 3 u32s and executes the ICB.

mechanism.barriers: ICB setBarrier on every producer→consumer edge; omitted only on independent pairs (gate/up, qkvz/ba, k/v after q).
mechanism.mha_shmem: oversized to (max_seq_len + 128) floats so dispatch geometry stays fixed while seq_len lives in the packed arg buffer

measurement.regime: warm after one discarded cold generate; 3 alternating A/B pairs = 6 in-process generates; steady = decode steps only (Q80 rule; last prefill emits new-token[0])

named_fixed_components_ns.basis: mean of each of 6 warm-rep per-step means, then mean across reps

wait_minus_gpu.note: ENCODE FELL AND WAIT ROSE. ICB execute has a larger host-side wait tail than 964 encoder boundaries. Reported, not hidden. Net named fixed still drops.

density_share_after.note: fixed 0.671 ms no longer scales with BPW; it is now a smaller tax than 1.415 ms
density_share_after.at_2_00_bpw_of_11_27_plus_fixed: if GPU scales and fixed stays 0.671, share is 0.671/11.27 ≈ 6.0% vs 12.6% before
